why: sentence 3 'Does he bite?' (habitual) and sentence 4 'He bit a thief' use the identical aorist form dénḱt in the same record, so the reference teaches one PIE string two English tenses; the PIE question reads 'did he bite?'. Lexeme denkjt-2 is aorist-only: rephrase the English (e.g. 'Has he ever bitten anyone?') or pick another construction.
